name: Grok Bot
summary: Talk to your Grok Bot AI teammates by voice.
description: See your Grok Bot teammates, message one, catch up on what a bot said, create a new bot, or start a group chat with several at once — all by voice, from the notch.

tools.name: view_bot_desktop_live
tools.title: View a bot's live screen
tools.description: Show a live view of a Grok Bot teammate's computer while it works. Use when the user asks to see a bot's screen, watch what a bot is doing, or what a bot is working on right now — e.g. "show me Pepper's screen", "what's Jerome working on".

bot.description: The bot's name as the user said it, e.g. 'Pepper'.

tools.name: grokbot_show
tools.title: Show bots
tools.description: Show the user's Grok Bot AI teammates, or one bot's live progress. Use when the user asks to see their bots, what bots they have, or what a specific bot is doing right now.

bot.description: A bot's name as the user said it, e.g. 'Pepper'. Omit to list every bot.

tools.name: grokbot_thread
tools.title: Read a bot's messages
tools.description: Read what one Grok Bot teammate said, found, or did. Use for ANY question about a bot's messages or results: what it said, summarize its work, answer a question from it, or draft something from it. Returns the message text in `thread`; read it and do what the user asked in your own words. Set show only when the user asks to see or open the conversation.

bot.description: The bot's name as the user said it.

limit.description: How many recent messages; omit for a short default.

show.description: True only when the user asks to see or open the conversation. Omit to just read it.

tools.name: grokbot_prepare_message
tools.title: Check message recipients
tools.description: Check the live Grok Bot roster and recent thread before drafting a message. Use FIRST for group messages or when recipient identity is uncertain; single-bot fast intents can call grokbot_send directly. Pass names as the user said them. This read-only lookup does not send or request confirmation. On success call nextTool with the returned args, including confirmationContext. On failure stop and explain the recipient could not be found; do not guess another bot, create a bot, or retry automatically.

bot.description: One bot's name as the user said it, or a known ID. Omit for groups.

group.description: An existing group's name as the user said it, or its ID.

members.description: Group members as the user said them, or their IDs.

groupName.description: A new group name, composed as the user would type it.

message.description: The draft, composed as the user would type it, with lead-in commands removed.

tools.name: grokbot_send
tools.title: Send to a bot

root.html:

Grok Bot

root.label: Grok Bot thread

tools.description: Send one message or task to one Grok Bot after the user reviews its confirmation. Accepts a known bot name or an exact ID from grokbot_prepare_message. The SDK preparation hook verifies its identity and supplies the native confirmation; a separate preparation call is optional for single bots. Unknown, ambiguous, or group recipients are rejected. Do not call after a failed lookup, substitute another bot, or automatically retry an uncertain delivery. Leave via unset on voice calls.

confirmationContext.description: Internal: copy confirmationContext unchanged from the successful grokbot_prepare_message result. Contains the live roster for the confirmation; never compose it yourself.

bot.description: One Grok Bot's name as spoken, or its exact ID from grokbot_prepare_message. The SDK hook verifies the recipient before confirmation.

message.description: The message or task, composed the way the user would type it — their meaning kept, lead-in verbs like 'tell Pepper to' dropped.

via.description: Internal — leave unset on voice calls. Card-origin metadata only; VoiceOS approval is required before execution.

recipientId.description: Internal: recipient ID pinned by the preparation hook. Never compose or change this value.

tools.name: grokbot_card_send
tools.title: Send from the bot card
tools.description: Internal — called only by the Grok Bot card's message box, never by voice. Do not call this tool; for a spoken request use grokbot_prepare_message then grokbot_send, which shows the user a confirmation first.

bot.description: 1:1 — the exact bot (or group) ID or name shown on the card.

group.description: Group thread — the existing group's ID. Omit with members for a new group.

members.description: Group thread — member bot IDs (edited on the card).

message.description: The text the user typed in the card.

tools.name: grokbot_create
tools.title: Create a bot
tools.description: Create a new Grok Bot teammate with a name and instructions. Use when the user asks to make, create, or set up a new bot.

name.description: A short name for the new bot, as the user said it.

description.description: The bot's job / instructions, composed the way the user would write them from what they asked for.

label.description: A one- or two-word tag for the bot (e.g. 'School', 'Research'), as the user said it.

notifications.description: Whether the bot should send notifications. Omit unless the user said.

color.description: Avatar color, one of Grok Bot's palette names. Comes from the card; omit unless the user named a color.

shape.description: Avatar shape, one of Grok Bot's picker shapes. Comes from the card; omit unless the user named a shape.

tools.title: Message a group chat

root.html:

root.label: Grok Bot thread

tools.description: Send to a verified Grok Bot group after the user reviews its thread confirmation. Use only AFTER grokbot_prepare_message succeeds for this request, copying its returned args including resolved group/member IDs and confirmationContext. Never call after a missing or ambiguous recipient lookup. The user can edit the draft, group name and members. Leave via unset on voice calls.

confirmationContext.description: Internal: copy confirmationContext unchanged from the successful grokbot_prepare_message result. Contains the live roster for the confirmation; never compose it yourself.

group.description: An existing group's name as the user said it, or its exact id from a card. Omit for a new group.

members.description: Bots to include, as names the user said or exact ids. Omit to use an existing group's members, or to choose members in the card.

groupName.description: The new or edited group name, composed as the user would type it. Omit to preserve an existing name; leave empty to name a new group in the card.

message.description: The drafted message, composed as the user would type it, with lead-in commands removed. The arrow sends the final edited text.

via.description: Internal — leave unset on voice calls. Card-origin metadata only; VoiceOS approval is required before execution.

tools.name: grokbot_card_snapshot
tools.title: Refresh conversation
tools.description: Internal read-only tool for the visible Grok Bot conversation card. Use grokbot_thread for spoken requests.

tools.name: grokbot_card_image
tools.title: Load conversation image
tools.description: Internal read-only image loader for Grok Bot cards. Resolves only an image belonging to the specified transcript entry.

tools.name: grokbot_card_action
tools.title: Respond to a conversation card
tools.description: Internal — only invoke from a user's click on a Grok Bot card. Never select or dismiss an answer on the user's behalf. Handles the exact selected options or opens Grok Bot's native authentication and approval flow.

tools.name: grokbot_card_files
tools.title: Attach files from the bot card
tools.description: Internal — only for explicit attachment picker, removal, send, and status actions in the Grok Bot card. Never call from a voice or model request.

tools.name: grokbot_card_teach
tools.title: Teach a task from the bot card
tools.description: Internal — only for the user's Teach a task controls. Prepare without recording; start, save, or discard only on the user's corresponding click. Never call from voice or model requests.

tools.name: grokbot_card_entry
tools.title: Load complete conversation message
tools.description: Internal read-only loader for complete Grok Bot messages. The card automatically reads bounded chunks; no user action or native-app handoff is needed.

tools.name: grokbot_open_computer_window
tools.title: Open a bot's computer window
tools.description: Internal — invoked by the live screen card when the user taps it, to open that bot's computer in a larger window. Do not call from voice.

bot.description: The bot's name or identifier as the user said it, e.g. 'Pepper'.

tools.name: grokbot_reply_check
tools.title: Check a bot's latest reply
tools.description: Internal — polled by the screen card's message bar after the user sends a message, to show the bot's reply on the card. Do not call from voice.

bot.description: The exact bot ID shown on the card.

since.description: Epoch milliseconds: only replies at or after this time count.

tools.name: grokbot_sent_recent
tools.title: List the user's latest messages to a bot
tools.description: Internal — called once by a sent receipt card when it loads, to re-list the follow-up messages the user sent from that card. Do not call from voice.

bot.description: The exact bot or group ID shown on the card.

intents.name: list_bots
intents.description: List the user's Grok Bot teammates and group chats. Only list bots, without sending a message or opening a bot's computer.

intents.name: show_bot
intents.description: Open one known Grok Bot's conversation and current progress. Do not send a message or show its computer screen.

intents.name: send_message
intents.description: Prepare one message to one known Grok Bot for the user's approval. Copy the message without the command lead-in, preserving its meaning. Multiple questions inside that message are one send. Reject unknown bots, groups, multiple recipients, or separate actions outside the message.

intents.name: view_screen
intents.description: Show the live screen of ONE named bot in the notch: see its screen, watch it, or what it is working on. Not a bigger or separate window, not its messages.

intents.name: open_chat
intents.description: Open or show the conversation with ONE named bot. Only for seeing or opening the chat. Not for questions about what the bot said, summaries, or sending a message.

intents.name: create_bot
intents.description: Create a new Grok bot when the user gives BOTH a name and what the bot should do. Not when either is missing.

en: Make a new bot called {name} to {description}
